name: 防滑高弹加厚瑜伽垫款
description: 加厚减震回弹、双面防滑纹理、抗水易洁、多色可选瑜伽垫套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: flat apple-green panels #93BA5A with a lighter diagonal split #A9C878 alternating with clean white #FFFFFF infographic sections
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill and soft contact shadows; punchier directional light only for dynamic splash shots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: light wood floor #D9C6A8 in scene shots, seamless studio sweep for product shots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines 28-48pt in charcoal #3A3A3A with black-plus-green duotone accents on infographic screens, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: consistent rounded-corner cards and pill labels with thin-line icons, one lemon-yellow accent #F2C230
styleLock.presentationRules: rolled mats always shown as neat cylinders with visible spiral ends; flat mat taut and wrinkle-free; stable hero angle and scale across benefit shots
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh yoga-fitness ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, apple-green panel #93BA5A, light bean-green card #DCE9BC, charcoal text #3A3A3A and one lemon-yellow accent #F2C230; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with black-plus-green duotone accents; consistent rounded-corner cards and pill labels with thin-line icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal flat infographic elements; rolled mats always presented as neat cylinders with visible spiral ends and the flat mat taut and wrinkle-free; fully composed frames with balanced margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏一秒传达加厚防滑高弹卖点与多色选择，赢取点击
shots.camera: slightly elevated 3/4 angle close to ground level, roll spiral ends facing the camera, full stack visible
shots.lighting: bright soft studio light from front-left, gentle fill, soft contact shadows under the rolls
shots.background: flat apple-green #93BA5A with a lighter diagonal panel #A9C878
shots.props: a few sparse minimal paper-triangle confetti in #F2C230 and #FFFFFF
shots.textZone: top-left headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF, one solid lemon-yellow rounded badge #F2C230 with white text 「{callout_1}」, and a row of three small solid color-dot markers below
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce hero banner of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three tightly rolled units of {product} stacked in a neat pyramid, photographed from a slightly elevated 3/4 angle close to ground level with the roll spiral ends facing the camera. Flat apple-green background #93BA5A with a lighter diagonal panel #A9C878 behind, sparse minimal paper-triangle confetti in #F2C230 and #FFFFFF. The upper third carries the composed typography: top-left headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF sized 28-48pt, below it one solid lemon-yellow rounded badge #F2C230 with white text 「{callout_1}」, and a row of three small solid color-dot markers. Bright soft studio light from front-left, soft contact shadows grounding the rolls. The rolled product group fills 60-70% of the frame in the lower half, with the type block and the stack balancing the tall canvas edge to edge. Crisp commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logos or embossed lettering, no readable filler text, no dense copy blocks, no watermark, no hands, no distorted roll spirals, no gradient banding, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 真实馆内场景代入，展示垫面铺展的稳定与舒适
shots.camera: eye-level from behind at a slight 3/4 angle, practitioner centered on the mat, face not visible
shots.lighting: soft natural window light from the left, 5500K, gentle soft shadows
shots.background: white painted brick wall #F4F2EE with light wood floor #D9C6A8
shots.props: one folded towel at the frame edge, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: natural breathing room from the brick wall and the wood floor around the mat
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} laid flat and taut on a light wood floor #D9C6A8 in a bright home studio with a white painted brick wall #F4F2EE. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A fitness practitioner with generic features sits cross-legged in a meditation pose on the mat, photographed from behind at eye level with a slight 3/4 angle, face not visible. Soft natural window light from the left, 5500K, gentle soft shadows matching one light direction. One folded towel at the frame edge, not covering the product. The mat and the seated figure fill 50-60% of the frame with the brick wall and floor giving natural breathing room around them, and a short caption 「{callout_1}」 in #3A3A3A sits anchored at the bottom-left of the scene. Negative: no recognizable face, no brand logos, no extra text, no watermark, no cluttered props, no warped floor lines, no deformed hands or limbs.

shots.intent: 微距证明垫面颗粒均匀细密，支撑防滑与亲肤卖点
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, shallow depth of field, foreground ridges tack-sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing surface grain, controlled highlight
shots.background: the mat surface itself filling the frame, one corner blurring into soft light green #DCE9BC
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.textZone: one small annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in #3A3A3A along the top edge
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product} surface texture. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, shallow depth of field with the foreground ridges tack-sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the fine anti-slip grain and the evenly distributed closed-cell bubble pattern of the surface, controlled highlight, no blowout. The mat surface itself fills the frame, one corner blurring into soft light green #DCE9BC. The texture detail occupies 55-60% of the frame with margins kept minimal because the grain is the whole point, and one small annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in #3A3A3A sits along the top edge of the texture. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented material percentages, no certification marks, no extra text, no watermark, no over-smoothed plastic surface, no duplicated texture pattern.

shots.textZone: two short labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #3A3A3A on the right side
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail of {product} rolled into a tight cylinder, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the spiral cross-section end. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The roll-end spiral fills 55-60% of the frame on the left, showing the layered cross-section and the back-texture ribs where the mat curls inward. Soft directional studio light from the front-left with a controlled highlight along the spiral edge and a soft contact shadow on the clean white background #FFFFFF. Two short labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #3A3A3A are placed on the right side at 10-14pt, each aligned with the layer band and the ribbed back texture it describes. Negative: no thickness numbers or unit callouts, no fabricated spec data, no brand embossing, no extra text, no watermark, no fuzzy edges, no broken spiral geometry.

provenance.notes: 从 7 屏 800x1200 瑜伽垫详情长图切片提炼；已剥离垫面压印品牌字与水印、二维码会员促销标、原文案与模板文字、生产地信息及原厚度数值（数值一律不采信，参数槽位由模板文案字段填充且不承诺具体数字），场景模特改为 a fitness practitioner with generic features，不复刻面容。
